about: Daily grade 5 spelling lists for Ace (Canadian spelling). To add a day, append one object to "lists": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "words": [{"word", "definition", "sentence", optional "syllables" like "ad-ven-ture"}]}.

words.definition: an exciting or unusual experience
words.sentence: Our camping trip in the mountains was a real adventure.

words.definition: to think something is true
words.sentence: I believe our team can win the game on Saturday.

words.definition: wanting to learn or know more about something
words.sentence: The curious puppy sniffed every corner of the yard.

words.definition: to find or learn something for the first time
words.sentence: Scientists hope to discover new kinds of fish in the deep ocean.

words.definition: very, very big
words.sentence: The blue whale is an enormous animal, even bigger than a dinosaur.

words.definition: the one you like best
words.sentence: Pizza is my favourite food for Friday dinner.

words.definition: the things you know and have learned
words.sentence: Reading books every day grows your knowledge.

words.definition: something that is hard to understand or explain
words.sentence: Where my missing sock went is a total mystery.

words.definition: a person who lives next to or near you
words.sentence: Our neighbour waves hello every morning.

words.definition: to split apart, or kept apart
words.sentence: Please separate the recycling from the garbage.

words.definition: the framework of bones that supports a body
words.sentence: An adult human skeleton usually has 206 bones.

words.definition: a crack or break in a bone
words.sentence: The X-ray showed a small fracture in Ace's wrist.

words.definition: a mineral that helps bones grow hard and strong
words.sentence: Milk, yogurt, and cheese are good sources of calcium.

words.definition: a tough, flexible tissue that cushions joints and can harden into bone
words.sentence: The tip of your nose is made of cartilage, not bone.

words.definition: the soft tissue inside bones that makes blood cells
words.sentence: Red marrow inside bones produces new blood cells every day.

words.definition: a strong band of tissue that holds bones together at a joint
words.sentence: A twisted ankle can stretch a ligament and make walking painful.

words.definition: one of the small bones that form the spine
words.sentence: Each vertebra in the backbone helps protect the spinal cord.

words.definition: the way a person holds their body when sitting or standing
words.sentence: Good posture keeps your spine healthier when you sit at a desk.

words.definition: how tightly packed something is; for bones, how solid and strong they are
words.sentence: Exercise can increase bone density so bones break less easily.

words.definition: a natural substance, such as calcium, that the body uses to build strong bones
words.sentence: Bones store minerals that the body can use when it needs them.
